With mushrooms I can always think clearly, and I can walk around just fine and can concentrate or hold conversations fairly well.. For me, I like mushrooms more for the mental effect/change than trying to see weird psychedelic visuals.. It feels like I shed off my artificial layers from my personality that aren't part of my true real self, and end up with only my true feelings, personality, and thoughts.. I act quite a bit different when I am on them.. I feel like I am not even my body really, but that I am just a being that is in control of this body for the time being..

Mushrooms very much make me want to go outside and see nature.. Some times I would walk through the woods near our house with my friend (while tripping) and every thing just looked amazing.. Even though woods just consist of trees and leaves and dirt, every where we walked and every where I looked felt amazing, and every thing seemed like it was in high-definition.. (Think of when you see a REALLY big clear vivid HD TV in a store some where and you think "WOW that is an amazing picture")..

And yeah for me the after-glow usually lasts quite a while.. Many hours.. The come-down just seems very gradual, and eases you back in to your normal life again..
Actually when I start coming down, part of me feels like "No! I don't want to go back to normalness again!".. And yeah, you could just keep taking drugs all the time to try to stay in that happy space, but that would be like a (mental) dependence on them.. (mushrooms don't cause a physical dependence).. I am not the type of person that wants to have any sort of dependence on drugs.. So, to me, I consider the mushrooms' effects as a glimpse of what my personality and mental state COULD be like if I were willing to better my self and shed all of the artificial crap built-up from societal pressures and expectations etc..

And one more thing for any one who hasn't tried them much yet: You are supposed to take them when you are happy and in a good mood.. They seem (for me any way) to enhance what ever mood I am already in.. I personally have only taken them when I am in a great mood and I am hanging out with my few (but very close) very good friends..
